title: Salary commission raises for county officials
summary: The Police Commission voted to send a letter to the salary commission suggesting a 5% raise for the police chief after the salary commission suggested 3.5%. The Civil Service Commission later heard that the salary commission met June 12 and gave no raises to elected officials, directors or deputies.

timeline.text: The salary commission met June 12 and gave no raises to elected officials, directors or deputies.
The chair will send a letter to the salary commission with the commission's recommendations.
The commission approved the letter with eight yeses.
The chair asked for a motion to send a letter suggesting a 5% raise for the chief.
The salary commission has suggested a 3.5% raise for the chief.
